principle: A release gate is closed only when the required production evidence exists in the repository or from an authorized platform/hardware validation run.

characterMeshAAA.acceptance: Final production skeletal mesh is imported, referenced by the playable character, and signed off by content QA.

rigFacialAnimation.acceptance: Final skeleton/rig, animation set, facial setup and gameplay animation coverage are present and QA signed off.

pbrVfx.acceptance: Final authored PBR materials/textures/VFX are present, referenced by final assets, and content QA signed off.

finalMaps.acceptance: Final playable maps are authored in Unreal Editor and contain the release World Partition/Data Layer/HLOD setup.

audioVO.acceptance: Final mixed audio and approved voice-over are imported, referenced and content-QA signed off.

cinematics.acceptance: Final Level Sequences/cinematic assets are authored, integrated and reviewed.

localization.acceptance: All release languages pass linguistic, functional, truncation and terminology QA.

hardwareEvidence.PS5: Requires authorized development kit/SDK execution and recorded profiling results.
hardwareEvidence.XboxSeries: Requires authorized development kit/SDK execution and recorded profiling results.
hardwareEvidence.Switch2: Requires authorized development kit/SDK execution and recorded profiling results.
hardwareEvidence.PCReference: Requires approved reference hardware profiling evidence.

platformIntegration.PSN: Requires authorized first-party provider integration and credentials.
platformIntegration.Xbox: Requires authorized first-party provider integration and credentials.
platformIntegration.Nintendo: Requires authorized first-party provider integration and credentials.

storeAndCertification.storeSubmission: Requires publisher/developer portal access and actual submission records.
storeAndCertification.distributionSigning: Requires authorized production signing infrastructure and signed artifacts.
storeAndCertification.trcTcrCertification: Requires execution and approval through the applicable platform certification process.
